headline: Former Nigerian President Criticizes Tinubu Over Naira Devaluation
summary: Former President Olusegun Obasanjo sharply criticized President Bola Tinubu's economic policies, asserting that currency devaluations have severely diminished Nigerian living standards.
why: Nigeria's foreign exchange reforms and currency devaluations directly affect inflation, multinational corporate revenues, and sovereign debt service.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Intense political criticism highlights societal friction over currency depreciation and reform fallout.
